subhero.en: Humira, Enbrel, Stelara, Cosentyx, and Skyrizi are the five most-prescribed biologic drugs for rheumatoid arthritis, psoriasis, psoriatic arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, Crohn's disease, and ulcerative colitis, and their 2026 costs diverge dramatically depending on Medicare negotiation status and biosimilar competition. Enbrel and Stelara both carry Medicare-negotiated Maximum Fair Prices under the Inflation Reduction Act, $2,355 and $4,695 per month respectively, effective January 1, 2026, while Humira already has more than 10 FDA-approved biosimilars pushing cash prices as low as $550 per month. Cosentyx and Skyrizi remain full-price, patent-protected brands with no Medicare negotiation and no biosimilar competition in 2026. This comparison breaks down retail cash prices, GoodRx and specialty-pharmacy pricing, Medicare Part D and Medicaid rules, and each manufacturer's patient assistance program side by side.
subhero.es: Humira, Enbrel, Stelara, Cosentyx y Skyrizi son los cinco biologicos mas recetados para artritis reumatoide, psoriasis, artritis psoriasica, espondilitis anquilosante, enfermedad de Crohn y colitis ulcerosa, y sus costos de 2026 difieren dramaticamente segun el estado de negociacion de Medicare y la competencia de biosimilares. Enbrel y Stelara tienen Precios Maximos Justos negociados por Medicare bajo la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion, $2,355 y $4,695 por mes respectivamente, efectivo el 1 de enero de 2026, mientras que Humira ya tiene mas de 10 biosimilares aprobados por la FDA que reducen los precios en efectivo hasta $550 por mes. Cosentyx y Skyrizi siguen siendo marcas de precio completo protegidas por patente sin negociacion de Medicare ni competencia biosimilar en 2026.

quickAnswer.en: In 2026, brand-name biologic list prices for autoimmune disease range from about $6,922 per month for Humira to roughly $24,000 per single dose for Skyrizi (dosed every 12 weeks). Medicare Part D enrollees pay the IRA-negotiated Maximum Fair Price of $2,355 per month for Enbrel and $4,695 per 30-day supply for Stelara, both effective January 1, 2026; Humira was not selected for negotiation because generic biosimilar competition already existed, and Cosentyx and Skyrizi were not selected in either Round 1 (2026) or Round 2 (2027). More than 10 adalimumab biosimilars for Humira sell for $550 to $1,315 per month, and five ustekinumab biosimilars for Stelara launched in 2025. No biosimilar exists yet for Enbrel (blocked by patents until approximately 2029), Cosentyx (patent through January 2029), or Skyrizi (patent through approximately 2028). Each manufacturer runs a separate patient assistance program: AbbVie's myAbbVie Assist (Humira and Skyrizi, roughly 600% of the Federal Poverty Level), Amgen Safety Net Foundation (Enbrel), Janssen CarePath (Stelara, roughly 400% FPL), and the Novartis Patient Assistance Foundation (Cosentyx, roughly 500% FPL). All Part D out-of-pocket spending across any of these drugs counts toward the same 2026 annual $2,100 cap.
quickAnswer.es: En 2026, los precios de lista de marca para biologicos de enfermedad autoinmune van desde aproximadamente $6,922 por mes para Humira hasta cerca de $24,000 por dosis unica para Skyrizi (dosificado cada 12 semanas). Los inscritos en Medicare Parte D pagan el Precio Maximo Justo negociado por la IRA de $2,355 por mes para Enbrel y $4,695 por suministro de 30 dias para Stelara, ambos efectivos el 1 de enero de 2026; Humira no fue seleccionado para negociacion porque ya existia competencia biosimilar generica, y Cosentyx y Skyrizi no fueron seleccionados ni en la Ronda 1 (2026) ni en la Ronda 2 (2027). Mas de 10 biosimilares de adalimumab para Humira se venden entre $550 y $1,315 por mes, y cinco biosimilares de ustekinumab para Stelara se lanzaron en 2025. Aun no existe biosimilar para Enbrel (bloqueado por patentes hasta aproximadamente 2029), Cosentyx (patente hasta enero de 2029) o Skyrizi (patente hasta aproximadamente 2028). Cada fabricante opera un programa de asistencia al paciente separado: myAbbVie Assist de AbbVie (Humira y Skyrizi, aproximadamente 600% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza), Amgen Safety Net Foundation (Enbrel), Janssen CarePath (Stelara, aproximadamente 400% FPL) y la Fundacion de Asistencia al Paciente de Novartis (Cosentyx, aproximadamente 500% FPL). Todo el gasto de bolsillo de la Parte D entre cualquiera de estos medicamentos cuenta hacia el mismo limite anual de $2,100 de 2026.

callout.en: Two of the five biologics compared here were selected for Medicare's first round of Inflation Reduction Act price negotiation. Stelara (ustekinumab) carries a Maximum Fair Price of $4,695 for a 30-day supply, down 66% from a pre-negotiation list price of $13,836, effective January 1, 2026; CMS has confirmed Stelara will exit the negotiated-drug list in 2027 as biosimilar competition takes over. Enbrel (etanercept) carries a Maximum Fair Price of $2,355 per 30-day supply, down 67% from $7,106, also effective January 1, 2026. Humira was never eligible for Round 1 negotiation because more than 10 adalimumab biosimilars already competed with the brand before CMS finalized its selections in 2023; drugs with existing generic or biosimilar competition are excluded from selection under the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022. Cosentyx and Skyrizi were not selected in Round 1 (2026 effective prices) or in the 15-drug Round 2 list CMS announced in January 2025 for 2027 effective prices, so both remain at full list price for Medicare Part D beneficiaries without a manufacturer copay card or patient assistance program.

Stelara (ustekinumab) tiene un Precio Maximo Justo de $4,695 por un suministro de 30 dias, una reduccion del 66% desde un precio de lista previo a la negociacion de $13,836, efectivo el 1 de enero de 2026; CMS ha confirmado que Stelara saldra de la lista de medicamentos negociados en 2027 a medida que la competencia biosimilar tome el relevo. Enbrel (etanercept) tiene un Precio Maximo Justo de $2,355 por suministro de 30 dias, una reduccion del 67% desde $7,106, tambien efectivo el 1 de enero de 2026. Humira nunca fue elegible para la negociacion de la Ronda 1 porque mas de 10 biosimilares de adalimumab ya competian con la marca antes de que CMS finalizara sus selecciones en 2023. Cosentyx y Skyrizi no fueron seleccionados ni en la Ronda 1 (precios efectivos 2026) ni en la lista de 15 medicamentos de la Ronda 2 que CMS anuncio en enero de 2025 para precios efectivos en 2027, por lo que ambos siguen a precio de lista completo para los beneficiarios de Medicare Parte D sin una tarjeta de copago del fabricante o programa de asistencia al paciente.

introParagraphs.en: Humira (adalimumab), Enbrel (etanercept), Stelara (ustekinumab), Cosentyx (secukinumab), and Skyrizi (risankizumab) are the five biologic drugs most commonly prescribed for rheumatoid arthritis, psoriatic arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, and plaque psoriasis in the United States, with Stelara and Skyrizi also approved for Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis. Humira and Enbrel block tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha), an inflammation-driving protein. Stelara blocks interleukin-12 and interleukin-23 (IL-12/23). Cosentyx blocks interleukin-17A (IL-17A). Skyrizi blocks interleukin-23 (IL-23) specifically at the p19 subunit. That mechanism difference does not change how each drug is billed, but the five drugs have sharply different Medicare negotiation status, biosimilar availability, and manufacturer assistance programs in 2026, which is why comparing them side by side matters more for your wallet than the immunology does. For single-drug detail, see the dedicated pages for [Humira cost](/drug/humira-cost) and [Enbrel cost](/drug/enbrel-cost).
introParagraphs.es: Humira (adalimumab), Enbrel (etanercept), Stelara (ustekinumab), Cosentyx (secukinumab) y Skyrizi (risankizumab) son los cinco biologicos mas comunmente recetados para artritis reumatoide, artritis psoriasica, espondilitis anquilosante y psoriasis en placas en Estados Unidos, y Stelara y Skyrizi tambien estan aprobados para enfermedad de Crohn y colitis ulcerosa. Humira y Enbrel bloquean el factor de necrosis tumoral alfa (TNF-alfa), una proteina que impulsa la inflamacion. Stelara bloquea interleucina-12 e interleucina-23 (IL-12/23). Cosentyx bloquea interleucina-17A (IL-17A). Skyrizi bloquea interleucina-23 (IL-23) especificamente en la subunidad p19. Esa diferencia de mecanismo no cambia como se factura cada medicamento, pero los cinco tienen un estado de negociacion de Medicare, disponibilidad de biosimilares y programas de asistencia del fabricante muy diferentes en 2026.

introParagraphs.en: The Inflation Reduction Act of 2022, signed August 16, 2022, authorized CMS to negotiate Medicare drug prices directly with manufacturers for the first time. Enbrel and Stelara were both among the first 10 drugs selected for Round 1 negotiation, and their Maximum Fair Prices of $2,355 and $4,695 took effect January 1, 2026. Humira was excluded from that selection entirely because more than 10 adalimumab biosimilars had already launched by 2023, and the statute bars CMS from selecting drugs that already face generic or biosimilar competition. Cosentyx and Skyrizi were not chosen for Round 1, and neither appeared on the 15-drug Round 2 list CMS announced in January 2025 for prices effective in 2027 (a list dominated by semaglutide products, oncology drugs, and COPD inhalers). That means Cosentyx and Skyrizi patients on Medicare Part D pay standard formulary cost-sharing on the full list price in 2026, with no Maximum Fair Price ceiling and no negotiated relief on the horizon.
introParagraphs.es: La Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion de 2022, firmada el 16 de agosto de 2022, autorizo a CMS a negociar directamente los precios de medicamentos de Medicare con los fabricantes por primera vez. Enbrel y Stelara estuvieron entre los primeros 10 medicamentos seleccionados para la negociacion de la Ronda 1, y sus Precios Maximos Justos de $2,355 y $4,695 entraron en vigor el 1 de enero de 2026. Humira fue excluido por completo de esa seleccion porque mas de 10 biosimilares de adalimumab ya se habian lanzado para 2023, y la ley prohibe a CMS seleccionar medicamentos que ya enfrentan competencia generica o biosimilar. Cosentyx y Skyrizi no fueron elegidos para la Ronda 1, y ninguno aparecio en la lista de 15 medicamentos de la Ronda 2 que CMS anuncio en enero de 2025 para precios efectivos en 2027.

introParagraphs.en: Patients switching between these five biologics for cost reasons should talk to their prescriber first, since none are clinically interchangeable and switching mechanisms of action can trigger a loss of disease control. Adalimumab (Humira) and ustekinumab (Stelara) both have FDA-approved biosimilars on the US market as of 2026, so a same-molecule switch within either drug family is often the easiest cost-saving move. Etanercept (Enbrel), secukinumab (Cosentyx), and risankizumab (Skyrizi) have no biosimilar competition in the US yet, so cost relief for those three depends entirely on Medicare negotiation status (Enbrel only), manufacturer copay cards for commercially-insured patients, or income-based patient assistance programs. The comparison table below lays out cash price, Medicare Part D treatment, biosimilar availability, and manufacturer patient assistance program for all five drugs side by side.
introParagraphs.es: Los pacientes que cambian entre estos cinco biologicos por razones de costo deben hablar primero con su medico prescriptor, ya que ninguno es clinicamente intercambiable entre si y cambiar de mecanismo de accion puede provocar una perdida del control de la enfermedad. Adalimumab (Humira) y ustekinumab (Stelara) tienen biosimilares aprobados por la FDA en el mercado de EE.UU. a partir de 2026, por lo que un cambio dentro de la misma familia de moleculas suele ser el movimiento de ahorro de costos mas facil. Etanercept (Enbrel), secukinumab (Cosentyx) y risankizumab (Skyrizi) no tienen competencia biosimilar en EE.UU. todavia, por lo que el alivio de costos para esos tres depende completamente del estado de negociacion de Medicare (solo Enbrel), tarjetas de copago del fabricante para pacientes con seguro comercial, o programas de asistencia al paciente basados en ingresos.

paragraphs.en: Hospitals rarely bill any of these five biologics as a standalone pharmacy line item during a routine outpatient visit, because Humira, Enbrel, and Cosentyx are almost always self-injected at home. Stelara and Skyrizi are the two exceptions: both offer an intravenous (IV) loading-dose option for Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, administered in an infusion center or hospital outpatient department, which can bill at facility rates of $15,000 to $180,000 per infusion depending on the facility and dose. Private insurers negotiate their own bundled infusion rates separately from any single drug's retail price, and uninsured patients face the hospital's full chargemaster rate for that same infusion.
paragraphs.es: Los hospitales rara vez facturan alguno de estos cinco biologicos como una linea de farmacia independiente durante una visita ambulatoria de rutina, porque Humira, Enbrel y Cosentyx casi siempre se autoinyectan en casa. Stelara y Skyrizi son las dos excepciones: ambos ofrecen una opcion de dosis de carga intravenosa (IV) para la enfermedad de Crohn y la colitis ulcerosa, administrada en un centro de infusion o departamento ambulatorio hospitalario, que puede facturarse a tarifas de instalacion de $15,000 a $180,000 por infusion segun la instalacion y la dosis.

paragraphs.en: Medicare Part B covers the IV induction dose for Stelara and Skyrizi under HCPCS codes J3358 and J2327 respectively, paid at ASP plus 6%, while the ongoing subcutaneous maintenance dose for either drug typically shifts to Medicare Part D once the patient transitions to home self-injection. That Part A or Part B to Part D transition is where the 2026 IRA Maximum Fair Price for Stelara ($4,695 per 30-day supply) kicks in, along with standard Part D formulary tier cost-sharing for the drugs without a negotiated price. Patients discharged on a new biologic prescription without an active Part D plan often face sticker shock at the outpatient specialty pharmacy because they assumed the inpatient or infusion-center rate would carry over.
paragraphs.es: Medicare Parte B cubre la dosis de induccion IV para Stelara y Skyrizi bajo los codigos HCPCS J3358 y J2327 respectivamente, pagados a ASP mas 6%, mientras que la dosis de mantenimiento subcutanea continua para cualquiera de los dos medicamentos generalmente pasa a Medicare Parte D una vez que el paciente hace la transicion a la autoinyeccion en casa. Esa transicion de Parte A o Parte B a Parte D es donde entra en vigor el Precio Maximo Justo IRA 2026 para Stelara ($4,695 por suministro de 30 dias), junto con el costo compartido estandar del nivel de formulario de Parte D para los medicamentos sin un precio negociado.

paragraphs.en: None of the five biologics has a small-molecule generic, so the cost-reduction pathway that lowers prices for drugs like Eliquis or metformin (ANDA generic competition) simply does not apply here. Cost reduction for Humira and Stelara comes from FDA-approved biosimilar competition under the Biologics Price Competition and Innovation Act; cost reduction for Enbrel and Stelara additionally comes from IRA Medicare negotiation; and cost reduction for Cosentyx and Skyrizi, which have neither biosimilar competition nor a negotiated price in 2026, depends entirely on manufacturer copay cards for commercially-insured patients or income-based patient assistance programs for everyone else.
paragraphs.es: Ninguno de los cinco biologicos tiene un generico de molecula pequena, por lo que la via de reduccion de costos que baja los precios de medicamentos como Eliquis o metformina (competencia generica ANDA) simplemente no aplica aqui. La reduccion de costos para Humira y Stelara proviene de la competencia biosimilar aprobada por la FDA bajo la Ley de Competencia e Innovacion de Precios de Biologicos; la reduccion de costos para Enbrel y Stelara ademas proviene de la negociacion de Medicare IRA; y la reduccion de costos para Cosentyx y Skyrizi, que no tienen ni competencia biosimilar ni un precio negociado en 2026, depende completamente de tarjetas de copago del fabricante o programas de asistencia al paciente basados en ingresos.

note.en: The five biologics compared here have three different biosimilar outcomes. Humira (adalimumab) has the most mature biosimilar market: more than 10 FDA-approved biosimilars, 7 with the interchangeable designation, available since 2023, with cash prices as low as $550 per month. Stelara (ustekinumab) followed with 5 FDA-approved biosimilars (Wezlana, Selarsdi, Steqeyma, Yesintek, Pyzchiva) launching throughout 2025, though discount pricing for these is still developing as of 2026. Enbrel (etanercept) has two FDA-approved biosimilars (Erelzi, approved 2016, and Eticovo, approved 2019) that remain blocked from the US market by patent litigation settlements until approximately 2029, so no cost relief from biosimilar competition exists for Enbrel patients today. Cosentyx (secukinumab) and Skyrizi (risankizumab) have no FDA-approved biosimilar in any market status; Novartis's core secukinumab patent runs through January 2029 and AbbVie's risankizumab patents are estimated to extend to approximately 2028, so neither drug faces any biosimilar competition in 2026 or the near future. None of the five is a small-molecule drug, so the traditional generic (ANDA) pathway does not apply to any of them; the biosimilar pathway under the Biologics Price Competition and Innovation Act (BPCIA) is the only cost-reduction avenue available, and it currently benefits only Humira and Stelara patients.
note.es: Los cinco biologicos comparados aqui tienen tres resultados biosimilares diferentes. Humira (adalimumab) tiene el mercado de biosimilares mas maduro: mas de 10 biosimilares aprobados por la FDA, 7 con la designacion de intercambiable, disponibles desde 2023, con precios en efectivo tan bajos como $550 por mes. Stelara (ustekinumab) siguio con 5 biosimilares aprobados por la FDA (Wezlana, Selarsdi, Steqeyma, Yesintek, Pyzchiva) lanzados durante 2025, aunque el precio de descuento para estos aun se esta desarrollando a partir de 2026. Enbrel (etanercept) tiene dos biosimilares aprobados por la FDA (Erelzi, aprobado en 2016, y Eticovo, aprobado en 2019) que permanecen bloqueados del mercado de EE.UU. por acuerdos de litigio de patentes hasta aproximadamente 2029. Cosentyx (secukinumab) y Skyrizi (risankizumab) no tienen ningun biosimilar aprobado por la FDA en ningun estado de mercado; la patente principal de secukinumab de Novartis dura hasta enero de 2029 y las patentes de risankizumab de AbbVie se estiman hasta aproximadamente 2028.

paragraphs.en: Medicare Part D treats these five biologics very differently in 2026. Enbrel and Stelara are subject to the IRA Maximum Fair Price of $2,355 and $4,695 per month respectively, applied at any network pharmacy regardless of which specific plan you carry. Humira, Cosentyx, and Skyrizi have no negotiated price; your out-of-pocket cost depends entirely on your Part D plan's formulary tier, and most plans place adalimumab biosimilars on a much lower tier than brand Humira while placing full-price Cosentyx and Skyrizi on their highest specialty tier. All out-of-pocket spending on any of the five drugs counts toward the same 2026 Part D annual out-of-pocket cap of $2,100; once you hit that cap across all your Part D drugs combined, you pay $0 for the rest of the calendar year.
paragraphs.es: Medicare Parte D trata a estos cinco biologicos de manera muy diferente en 2026. Enbrel y Stelara estan sujetos al Precio Maximo Justo IRA de $2,355 y $4,695 por mes respectivamente, aplicado en cualquier farmacia de la red sin importar el plan especifico que tenga. Humira, Cosentyx y Skyrizi no tienen un precio negociado; su costo de bolsillo depende completamente del nivel de formulario de su plan Parte D, y la mayoria de los planes colocan los biosimilares de adalimumab en un nivel mucho mas bajo que Humira de marca mientras colocan a Cosentyx y Skyrizi de precio completo en su nivel especializado mas alto.

paragraphs.en: Extra Help (the Part D Low Income Subsidy) reduces cost-sharing further for Medicare beneficiaries with limited income and resources. In 2026, Extra Help enrollees pay $12.65 per fill for a brand-name biologic like Cosentyx or Skyrizi, and a smaller copay for a biosimilar like adalimumab-adbm or Wezlana. Extra Help is generally available to beneficiaries with income at or below 150% of the Federal Poverty Level. Apply through the Social Security Administration at 1-800-772-1213 or at ssa.gov, and mention which specific biologic you take since eligibility rules for the manufacturer PAP on top of Extra Help vary by drug.
paragraphs.es: Extra Help (el Subsidio de Bajos Ingresos de la Parte D) reduce aun mas el costo compartido para los beneficiarios de Medicare con ingresos y recursos limitados. En 2026, los inscritos en Extra Help pagan $12.65 por reposicion para un biologico de marca como Cosentyx o Skyrizi, y un copago menor para un biosimilar como adalimumab-adbm o Wezlana. Solicite a traves de la Administracion del Seguro Social al 1-800-772-1213 o en ssa.gov.

intro.en: Billing problems for these five biologics tend to show up on specialty pharmacy claims or hospital Explanation of Benefits statements rather than at a routine retail pharmacy counter. Watch for these issues:
intro.es: Los problemas de facturacion para estos cinco biologicos tienden a aparecer en reclamos de farmacia especializada o en Explicaciones de Beneficios hospitalarias en lugar de en un mostrador de farmacia minorista de rutina. Verifique estos problemas:

items.en: Pharmacy charges more than the $2,355 Enbrel or $4,695 Stelara IRA Maximum Fair Price for a Medicare Part D fill in 2026, which violates federal law; ask your plan's member services to reprocess the claim.
items.es: La farmacia cobra mas del Precio Maximo Justo IRA de $2,355 para Enbrel o $4,695 para Stelara en una reposicion de Medicare Parte D en 2026, lo que viola la ley federal; pida al servicio de miembros de su plan que reprocese el reclamo.

items.en: Adalimumab or ustekinumab biosimilar billed at the brand-name price instead of its own lower ASP or Part D tier.
items.es: Biosimilar de adalimumab o ustekinumab facturado al precio de marca en lugar de su propio ASP o nivel de Parte D mas bajo.

items.en: Manufacturer copay card applied for a patient who has Medicare or Medicaid, which is prohibited and can result in a claim clawback later.
items.es: Tarjeta de copago del fabricante aplicada a un paciente que tiene Medicare o Medicaid, lo cual esta prohibido y puede resultar en una recuperacion del reclamo mas tarde.

items.en: Step therapy denial for Cosentyx or Skyrizi requiring a TNF inhibitor trial without documenting that the TNF inhibitor is clinically inappropriate or was already tried and failed.
items.es: Denegacion de terapia escalonada para Cosentyx o Skyrizi que requiere una prueba de inhibidor de TNF sin documentar que el inhibidor de TNF es clinicamente inapropiado o que ya se probo y fallo.

items.en: IV induction dose for Stelara or Skyrizi billed under a J-code that does not match the specific drug administered, which can trigger an incorrect copay or coverage denial.
items.es: Dosis de induccion IV para Stelara o Skyrizi facturada bajo un codigo J que no coincide con el medicamento especifico administrado, lo que puede provocar un copago incorrecto o denegacion de cobertura.

items.en: Charged the standard copay after you already hit the $2,100 Part D annual out-of-pocket cap for the year across all your combined Part D drugs.
items.es: Se le cobro el copago estandar despues de que ya alcanzo el limite anual de bolsillo de la Parte D de $2,100 para el ano entre todos sus medicamentos combinados de Parte D.

appealSteps.en: Step 1: Request a written denial notice from your insurer or Part D plan. Federal law requires written notice within 72 hours for standard decisions, or 24 hours for expedited (urgent) requests, stating the specific reason for denial and your appeal rights.
appealSteps.es: Paso 1: Solicite un aviso de denegacion por escrito de su aseguradora o plan Parte D. La ley federal requiere aviso escrito dentro de las 72 horas para decisiones estandar, o 24 horas para solicitudes urgentes.

appealSteps.en: Step 2: File a formal appeal within 60 days of the written denial. Include a prescriber letter documenting medical necessity and why the plan's preferred alternative (often a cheaper TNF inhibitor or a required biosimilar) is not clinically appropriate for your condition.
appealSteps.es: Paso 2: Presente una apelacion formal dentro de los 60 dias del aviso de denegacion por escrito. Incluya una carta del medico prescriptor que documente la necesidad medica.

appealSteps.en: Step 3: Ask your prescriber to request a peer-to-peer review with the plan's medical director, documenting why other biologics are contraindicated, already failed, or carry specific risks given your comorbidities.
appealSteps.es: Paso 3: Solicite a su medico prescriptor que pida una revision medico a medico con el director medico del plan, documentando por que otros biologicos estan contraindicados o ya fallaron.

appealSteps.en: Step 4: If the internal appeal is denied, escalate to an Independent Review Entity for Medicare Part D plans at 1-800-633-4227, or to your state Department of Insurance for commercial plans. Medicare beneficiaries can also contact their State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP) for free counseling.
appealSteps.es: Paso 4: Si la apelacion interna es denegada, escale a una Entidad de Revision Independiente para planes Medicare Parte D al 1-800-633-4227, o al Departamento de Seguros de su estado para planes comerciales.

stepTherapyOverride.en: If your plan requires step therapy (trying a cheaper TNF inhibitor or biosimilar first before covering Cosentyx or Skyrizi), your prescriber can file a step-therapy exception by documenting that the required first-step drug is medically contraindicated, was already tried and failed (inadequate disease control, adverse events, or intolerance), or that requiring it would cause serious harm given the urgency of your condition, such as rapidly progressing joint damage. Medicare and most state laws require plans to decide on a step-therapy exception within 72 hours of complete documentation, or 24 hours for urgent cases.
stepTherapyOverride.es: Si su plan requiere terapia escalonada (probar un inhibidor de TNF o biosimilar mas economico primero antes de cubrir Cosentyx o Skyrizi), su medico prescriptor puede presentar una excepcion de terapia escalonada documentando que el medicamento de primer paso requerido esta medicamente contraindicado, ya se probo y fallo, o que requerirlo causaria dano grave dada la urgencia de su condicion.

papFallback.en: If all insurance appeals fail, apply for the manufacturer PAP that matches your specific biologic: myAbbVie Assist for Humira or Skyrizi, Amgen Safety Net Foundation for Enbrel, Janssen CarePath for Stelara, or the Novartis Patient Assistance Foundation for Cosentyx. Each has a different FPL threshold, so check the one that applies to your prescribed drug before assuming you do not qualify.
papFallback.es: Si todas las apelaciones de seguro fallan, solicite el PAP del fabricante que corresponde a su biologico especifico: myAbbVie Assist para Humira o Skyrizi, Amgen Safety Net Foundation para Enbrel, Janssen CarePath para Stelara, o la Fundacion de Asistencia al Paciente de Novartis para Cosentyx.

genericAlternative.en: Adalimumab biosimilars (for Humira) are the most complete same-molecule alternative among the five, at $550 to $1,315 per month, and ustekinumab biosimilars (for Stelara) launched throughout 2025 offer a second option. No biosimilar exists for Enbrel, Cosentyx, or Skyrizi as of 2026. Switching to a different biologic class entirely (for example, from Cosentyx to a lower-cost TNF inhibitor) is a clinical decision, not just a cost decision, and should only happen with your prescriber's guidance given the risk of losing disease control.
genericAlternative.es: Los biosimilares de adalimumab (para Humira) son la alternativa mas completa de la misma molecula entre los cinco, a $550 a $1,315 por mes, y los biosimilares de ustekinumab (para Stelara) lanzados durante 2025 ofrecen una segunda opcion. No existe biosimilar para Enbrel, Cosentyx o Skyrizi a partir de 2026. Cambiar a una clase de biologico completamente diferente es una decision clinica, no solo de costo, y debe hacerse solo con la orientacion de su medico prescriptor.

en.question: Is there a generic or biosimilar for Humira, Enbrel, Stelara, Cosentyx, or Skyrizi?
en.answer: Yes for two of the five. Humira has more than 10 FDA-approved adalimumab biosimilars, 7 with the interchangeable designation, available since 2023 at $550 to $1,315 per month. Stelara has 5 FDA-approved ustekinumab biosimilars (Wezlana, Selarsdi, Steqeyma, Yesintek, Pyzchiva) that launched throughout 2025. Enbrel has two FDA-approved biosimilars blocked from the US market by patent settlements until approximately 2029. Cosentyx and Skyrizi have no biosimilar in any market status as of 2026, with core patents running through roughly 2028 to 2029.

en.question: How do I apply for a biologic manufacturer patient assistance program?
en.answer: Apply to the manufacturer of your specific drug: myAbbVie Assist at abbvieaccess.com for Humira or Skyrizi, Amgen Safety Net Foundation at amgensafetynetfoundation.com for Enbrel, Janssen CarePath at jnjwithme.com for Stelara, or the Novartis Patient Assistance Foundation at pap.novartis.com for Cosentyx. Each requires proof of income, proof of US residency, a valid prescription, and documentation that you have no prescription drug coverage for that drug. Processing takes 7 to 15 business days, and approved patients typically receive a 12-month supply that requires annual re-enrollment.

en.question: Can I use a biologic manufacturer copay card with Medicare?
en.answer: No. Federal anti-kickback law (42 U.S.C. Section 1320a-7b) bars Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE, and VA beneficiaries from using any manufacturer copay card, including HUMIRA Complete, the Enbrel Co-Pay Program, Stelara withMe, Cosentyx Connect, and Skyrizi Complete. Medicare Part D patients on Enbrel or Stelara should instead rely on the 2026 IRA Maximum Fair Price ($2,355 and $4,695 respectively), and patients on Humira, Cosentyx, or Skyrizi should apply for Part D Extra Help or the matching manufacturer PAP if they cannot afford the formulary copay.

en.question: What if my insurance denies coverage for my biologic or requires step therapy first?
en.answer: Request a written denial notice, then file a formal appeal within 60 days with a prescriber letter documenting medical necessity. If your plan requires step therapy with a cheaper biologic or biosimilar, your prescriber can file a step-therapy exception documenting contraindication, prior failure, or urgent risk such as rapidly progressing joint damage. If the appeal fails, apply for the manufacturer PAP that matches your specific drug as a fallback.

en.question: Does the IRA negotiated price apply to Humira, Enbrel, Stelara, Cosentyx, or Skyrizi?
en.answer: It applies to two of the five. Enbrel and Stelara were both selected for Medicare's first round of Inflation Reduction Act negotiation, with Maximum Fair Prices of $2,355 and $4,695 per 30-day supply respectively, effective January 1, 2026. Humira was never eligible because biosimilar competition already existed before CMS finalized its Round 1 selections in 2023. Cosentyx and Skyrizi were not selected in Round 1 or in the 15-drug Round 2 list announced in January 2025 for 2027 effective prices, so both remain unnegotiated for the foreseeable future.

en.question: What does each biologic cost without insurance at the pharmacy counter in 2026?
en.answer: Without insurance, Humira brand runs $6,922 per month while its biosimilars run $550 to $1,315 per month. Enbrel runs $6,800 to $7,500 per month. Cosentyx runs about $8,492 per month at list price. Stelara runs $11,000 to $17,000 per single injection at its 8-to-12-week dosing interval. Skyrizi runs $20,200 to $24,000 per single dose at its 12-week maintenance interval. Only Humira has broad discount-coupon availability across retail pharmacies; the other four are distributed through specialty pharmacy networks at close to list price without a manufacturer copay card.

en.question: Do I qualify for a biologic patient assistance program based on my income?
en.answer: It depends on which drug you take, since each manufacturer sets a different income cutoff. myAbbVie Assist for Humira and Skyrizi generally requires household income at or below 600% of the Federal Poverty Level ($95,760 for one person in 2026). Janssen CarePath for Stelara uses roughly 400% FPL. The Novartis Patient Assistance Foundation for Cosentyx uses roughly 500% FPL. Amgen Safety Net Foundation for Enbrel sets its own separate income limits. Check the specific program for your prescribed drug rather than assuming one threshold applies to all five.

en.question: Which biologic is cheapest for autoimmune disease in 2026: Humira, Enbrel, Stelara, Cosentyx, or Skyrizi?
en.answer: For uninsured patients without a manufacturer PAP, an adalimumab biosimilar (for Humira) is the cheapest at $550 to $1,315 per month, since it is the only one of the five with broad, mature biosimilar competition. For Medicare Part D patients, Enbrel and Stelara are often cheapest in practice because their 2026 IRA Maximum Fair Prices ($2,355 and $4,695) are capped by law, while Cosentyx and Skyrizi cost depends entirely on your plan's formulary tier for the full list price. Your prescriber, not cost alone, should guide which biologic is clinically right for your specific condition.

es.question: ¿Hay un generico o biosimilar para Humira, Enbrel, Stelara, Cosentyx o Skyrizi?
es.answer: Si para dos de los cinco. Humira tiene mas de 10 biosimilares de adalimumab aprobados por la FDA, 7 con la designacion de intercambiable, disponibles desde 2023 a $550 a $1,315 por mes. Stelara tiene 5 biosimilares de ustekinumab aprobados por la FDA lanzados durante 2025. Enbrel tiene dos biosimilares aprobados por la FDA bloqueados del mercado de EE.UU. por acuerdos de patente hasta aproximadamente 2029. Cosentyx y Skyrizi no tienen ningun biosimilar en 2026, con patentes principales hasta aproximadamente 2028 a 2029.

es.question: ¿Como solicito un programa de asistencia al paciente para un biologico?
es.answer: Solicite al fabricante de su medicamento especifico: myAbbVie Assist en abbvieaccess.com para Humira o Skyrizi, Amgen Safety Net Foundation en amgensafetynetfoundation.com para Enbrel, Janssen CarePath en jnjwithme.com para Stelara, o la Fundacion de Asistencia al Paciente de Novartis en pap.novartis.com para Cosentyx. Cada uno requiere comprobante de ingresos, comprobante de residencia en EE.UU., una receta valida y documentacion de que no tiene cobertura de medicamentos con receta para ese medicamento.

es.question: ¿Puedo usar una tarjeta de copago del fabricante de un biologico con Medicare?
es.answer: No. La ley federal anti-soborno (42 U.S.C. Seccion 1320a-7b) prohibe a los beneficiarios de Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE y VA usar cualquier tarjeta de copago del fabricante, incluyendo HUMIRA Complete, el Programa de Copago Enbrel, Stelara withMe, Cosentyx Connect y Skyrizi Complete. Los pacientes de Medicare Parte D con Enbrel o Stelara deben confiar en el Precio Maximo Justo IRA de 2026 en su lugar.

es.question: ¿Que hago si mi seguro deniega la cobertura de mi biologico o requiere terapia escalonada primero?
es.answer: Solicite un aviso de denegacion por escrito, luego presente una apelacion formal dentro de los 60 dias con una carta del medico prescriptor que documente la necesidad medica. Si su plan requiere terapia escalonada con un biologico o biosimilar mas economico, su medico prescriptor puede presentar una excepcion documentando contraindicacion, fallo previo o riesgo urgente. Si la apelacion falla, solicite el PAP del fabricante que corresponde a su medicamento especifico.

es.question: ¿Aplica el precio negociado de la IRA a Humira, Enbrel, Stelara, Cosentyx o Skyrizi?
es.answer: Aplica a dos de los cinco. Enbrel y Stelara fueron seleccionados para la primera ronda de negociacion de Medicare bajo la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion, con Precios Maximos Justos de $2,355 y $4,695 por suministro de 30 dias respectivamente, efectivos el 1 de enero de 2026. Humira nunca fue elegible porque la competencia biosimilar ya existia antes de que CMS finalizara sus selecciones de la Ronda 1 en 2023. Cosentyx y Skyrizi no fueron seleccionados en la Ronda 1 ni en la lista de 15 medicamentos de la Ronda 2 anunciada en enero de 2025 para precios efectivos en 2027.

es.question: ¿Cuanto cuesta cada biologico sin seguro en la farmacia en 2026?
es.answer: Sin seguro, Humira de marca cuesta $6,922 por mes mientras que sus biosimilares cuestan $550 a $1,315 por mes. Enbrel cuesta $6,800 a $7,500 por mes. Cosentyx cuesta aproximadamente $8,492 por mes al precio de lista. Stelara cuesta $11,000 a $17,000 por inyeccion unica en su intervalo de dosificacion de 8 a 12 semanas. Skyrizi cuesta $20,200 a $24,000 por dosis unica en su intervalo de mantenimiento de 12 semanas.

es.question: ¿Califico para un programa de asistencia al paciente de un biologico segun mis ingresos?
es.answer: Depende de que medicamento tome, ya que cada fabricante establece un limite de ingresos diferente. myAbbVie Assist para Humira y Skyrizi generalmente requiere ingresos familiares al o por debajo del 600% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza ($95,760 para una persona en 2026). Janssen CarePath para Stelara usa aproximadamente 400% FPL. La Fundacion de Asistencia al Paciente de Novartis para Cosentyx usa aproximadamente 500% FPL. Amgen Safety Net Foundation para Enbrel establece sus propios limites de ingresos separados.

es.question: ¿Cual biologico es mas barato para enfermedad autoinmune en 2026: Humira, Enbrel, Stelara, Cosentyx o Skyrizi?
es.answer: Para pacientes sin seguro y sin un PAP del fabricante, un biosimilar de adalimumab (para Humira) es el mas barato a $550 a $1,315 por mes, ya que es el unico de los cinco con competencia biosimilar amplia y madura. Para pacientes de Medicare Parte D, Enbrel y Stelara suelen ser los mas baratos en la practica porque sus Precios Maximos Justos IRA de 2026 estan limitados por ley, mientras que Cosentyx y Skyrizi dependen completamente del nivel de formulario de su plan. Su medico prescriptor, no solo el costo, debe guiar cual biologico es clinicamente adecuado para su condicion especifica.
